  • Expert proficiency in Figma

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to craft

  • You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

Nice to Have

  • Mobile gaming experience.

Hands-On Design

  • Create user-centric designs, wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for the JustPlay app

  • Develop features that elevate the entire player journey, with emphasis on game discovery and loyalty gamification

  • Drive measurable business outcomes through design decisions that balance player delight and company growth

  • Support evolving JustPlay's design guidelines and design system

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to develop innovative solutions within technical constraints

  • Apply platform best practices (iOS, Android) to ensure design quality and seamless interactions across devices

  • Transform research insights and analytics into actionable design concepts

  • Work with cross-functional leaders to identify where AI and automation can streamline design operations

Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain effective design processes that scale with your team

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance product usability

  • Stay current with mobile gaming trends and the advertising ecosystem

  • Foster a high-performing, growth-minded design team through mentorship and feedback

  • Champion product design throughout the organization, educating stakeholders and establishing design-led practices

  • Contribute to building a culture of craft, collaboration, and continuous learning

Job benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. background-color: #f8f8f8;">Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.</li> <li>Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.</li> <li>Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&amp;-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.</p> <p data-start="397" data-end="839">Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit <strong data-start="634" data-end="654">MediaMarktSaturn</strong> gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.</p> <p data-start="841" data-end="1203">Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.</p> <p data-start="1205" data-end="1518" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">Erfahre mehr über unsere Partnerschaft mit <a class="decorated-link" href="https://press.wolt.com/de-DE/268011-mediamarktsaturn-startet-auf-wolt-vom-smartphone-bis-zur-spielkonsole-technik-in-rund-35-minuten-geliefert/?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_new" data-start="1248" data-end="1411">MediaMarktSaturn</a> und entdecke die neuesten Updates im <a class="decorated-link" href="https://press.wolt.com/de-DE/tags/news/?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_new" data-start="1449" data-end="1517">Wolt Deutschland Newsroom</a>.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </section> </div> </div> </div> </header> <div class="block-wrapper"> <div class="max-w-lg block-content max-w-applicationForm"> <div class="job-detail-client-module__HnVBZW__wysiwygContainer grid grid-cols-1 justify-items-center"> <div class="wysiwyg mb-8 md:mb-10 lg:mb-12"> <h2><strong>Deine Hauptaufgaben bei Wolt</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Identifikation &amp; Akquise:</strong> Du bist verantwortlich für das Sourcing der besten Retail-Partner der Stadt. Dein Ziel ist es, Supermärkte und erstklassige Non-Food-Venues im Raum Berlin zu gewinnen und diese zu optimalen Konditionen auf die Wolt-Plattform zu bringen.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline-Management:</strong>&nbsp;Du steuerst deine Sales-Pipeline eigenständig und baust belastbare Netzwerke zu Inhaber:innen sowie Geschäftsleiter:innen im Einzelhandel auf.</li> <li><strong>Überzeugende Präsentation:&nbsp;</strong>Du positionierst Wolt als führende E-Commerce-Lösung. Dabei hörst du potenziellen Partnern aktiv zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und überzeugst Entscheidungsträger durch passgenaue Mehrwerte.</li> <li><strong>Präsenz vor Ort:&nbsp;</strong>Dein Fokus liegt auf dem Außendienst. Deine Woche besteht aus ca. 1–2 Tagen strategischer Planung und Cold Calling (Home Office) sowie 3–4 Tagen im Außendienst in Berlin (inkl. gelegentlicher Hotelübernachtungen).</li> <li><strong>Schnittstellenarbeit:</strong>&nbsp;Du arbeitest eng mit dem Onboarding-Team zusammen, um eine perfekte Abbildung deiner Partner – vom Supermarkt bis zum Blumenladen – auf unserer Plattform sicherzustellen.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Vertriebsprofi im Außendienst:</strong>&nbsp;Du hast bereits 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Sales und liebst den Kaltkundenkontakt. Es motiviert dich, Partner proaktiv vor Ort zu besuchen und zu überzeugen.</li> <li><strong>Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit:</strong>&nbsp;Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum&nbsp;<strong>C-Level-Entscheider</strong>. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.</li> <li><strong>Performance-Drive:</strong>&nbsp;Du willst der Beste sein und die&nbsp;<strong>Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt</strong>&nbsp;für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.</li> <li><strong>Selbstorganisation:</strong>&nbsp;Du planst deine&nbsp;<strong>Walk-in-Routen</strong>&nbsp;effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.</li> <li><strong>Positives Mindset:</strong>&nbsp;Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.</li> <li><strong>Qualifikation &amp; Sprache:</strong>&nbsp;Studium oder Ausbildung,&nbsp;<strong>fließendes Deutsch</strong>&nbsp;und gute Englischkenntnisse.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Was wir dir anbieten:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Gestalte die Zukunft des Handels:</strong>&nbsp;Wir verändern, wie Menschen einkaufen. Dein Job ist es, den lokalen Handel so effizient zu machen, dass unsere Kunden Zeit für Wichtigeres gewinnen, anstatt sie in Warteschlangen im Supermarkt zu verbringen.</li> <li><strong>Wachstum &amp; Impact:</strong> Nutze die steile Lernkurve eines globalen Tech-Unternehmens und entwickle unsere bereits etablierten Märkte in Berlin auf das nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Eigenverantwortung:</strong>&nbsp;Arbeite selbständig in einem dynamischen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und direktem Einfluss auf den Markterfolg.</li> <li><strong>Mobilität &amp; Equipment:</strong>&nbsp;Du erhältst Top-Hardware (iPhone &amp; MacBook) und die Option auf einen&nbsp;<strong>Firmenwagen</strong>&nbsp;für deine Einsätze im Außendienst.</li> <li><strong>Wolt-Benefits:</strong>&nbsp;Rabatte auf Wolt-Bestellungen, ÖPNV-Zuschuss sowie Wellness-Angebote (z. B. Urban Sports Club).</li> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance:</strong>&nbsp;30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nächste Schritte</strong></h2> <p>Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Screening:</strong>&nbsp;Ein erstes Gespräch mit unserem&nbsp;<strong>Recruiting-Team</strong>, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation für Wolt kennenzulernen.</li> <li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview:</strong>&nbsp;Ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit dem&nbsp;<strong>Hiring Manager</strong>, in dem wir mehr über deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Motivation für die Rolle erfahren möchten.</li> <li><strong>Role Play:</strong>&nbsp;Eine praxisnahe&nbsp;<strong>Sales-Übung</strong>, bei der du uns deinen Ansatz bei der Kundenansprache, im Pitch und im Umgang mit Einwänden zeigen kannst.</li> </ol> <h2><strong>Bereit, mit uns Geschichte zu schreiben?</strong></h2> <p>Wir verändern nicht nur den Handel – wir geben den Menschen Zeit für das zurück, was sie wirklich lieben. title: Director Technical Project Management / Delivery Lead
description: <p><span style="font-size: 12px;">WongDoody creates human experiences at 24 studios across 4 continents. We believe the future can be molded. And by shaping human experiences through creativity and tech, we work to build a future we believe in.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">For us, this starts with our own culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment where every human can bring their whole self to work. Our clients are brands we believe in, from global big players to local heroes to startups we love. With each of our partners, we embark on a journey of co-creation, pushing the boundaries of what's possible and exploring the space where creativity and tech meet.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">Our team of fun, welcoming, values-driven and collaborative problem solvers has one focus at the heart of everything we do: human experience. Human experiences are the touchpoints where brands connect with customers. And we transform businesses by creating engaging, inspiring moments using strategy, creativity, data and technology—all backed by the global technological power of Infosys.</span></p><p><strong style="font-size: 12px;">Experience &amp; Tech</strong></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">We are a cross-unit and cross-location tech and experience team. With more than 50 developers, UX designers and consultants working directly with other WongDoody teams, we are team players and specialists—both in frontend and backend. As part of Infosys, we belong to a leading global technology company with access to solutions and extensive know-how in the fields of commerce, marketing automation and AI, among others.&nbsp;</span></p><p><strong style="font-size: 12px;">Our local benefits</strong></p><ul><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Flexible working hours&nbsp;and 100% overtime compensation</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Work where it works for you. At home or in the office, or any mix you like&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Working for strong brands and clients we believe in&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">30 days' vacation per year&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Company Benefits</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Urban Sports Club&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Nice people in welcoming teams&nbsp;</span></li></ul><p><strong style="font-size: 12px;">What you can expect</strong></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">We are looking for you to lead our team in Germany as Director of Technical Project Management and Project Delivery, working on exciting international projects within interdisciplinary teams.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">You will be responsible for planning and managing the Technical Project Management Team (approx. 5–10 people) and its activities, as well as for the professional and personal development of team members.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">Your tasks and responsibilities will also include:</span></p><ul><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Implementing strategies to improve team and delivery performance, and providing regular reports.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Assisting with the recruitment of new team members and relevant partners.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Strategic and operational management of complex development and AI projects, including independent management of pitches, presentations and workshops</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Analyzing new project enquiries and deriving recommendations for action — with a focus on feasibility, staffing, efficiency and potential.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Leading interdisciplinary project teams (including backend, frontend and full-stack developers, AI engineers, and UI/UX designers) within the WongDoody Group and Infosys service lines — both nationally and internationally.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Supporting the development of AI-driven solutions in close collaboration with experts.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Contributing to the strategic development of the business unit in collaboration with management.</span></li></ul><p><strong style="font-size: 12px;">What we'd love to see</strong></p><ul><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">You have at least 5 years’ professional experience as a Technical Project Manager or Delivery Manager in an agency or services environment.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Experience in team leadership and development.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Strong experience in client relations and consulting, as well as scaling digital processes.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Excellent skills in coordinating complex digital, AI and development projects, including leading interdisciplinary teams.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Familiarity with common PM tools (Jira, Confluence, Salesforce, etc.).</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Curiosity about new technologies, workflows, and digital trends.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Advantage: experience with CGI, real-time workflows and MarTech solutions.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">You work independently and are characterized by a positive, solution-oriented and hands-on mindset.</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Flexibility to travel within Germany and internationally to collaborate with clients and global delivery teams when required.&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="font-size: 12px;">Fluent German (C1/C2) and good English skills (B2+) are essential.</span></li></ul><p><span style="font-size: 12px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">You’ll shape how complex digital and AI projects are delivered at scale — building high-performing teams, creating efficient delivery structures, and turning ambitious ideas into reliable, high-quality outcomes for clients.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">We care about your personality and professional skills. We don't care about your gender, age, nationality or appearance and are open to working with everyone.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 12px;">Please note: This is a job ad by WongDoody GmbH, based in Germany. Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) betreuen und administrieren Sie die gesamte IT-Infrastruktur mit Servern, Netzwerken, Clients und virtualisierten Systemen
  • Zudem verwalten Sie Windows-Server, Exchange und weitere zentrale Anwendungen und entwickeln die bestehende Systemumgebung kontinuierlich weiter
  • Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie die Benutzer- und Berechtigungsverwaltung und unterstützen Anwender bei Hard- und Softwareproblemen
  • Zusätzlich stellen Sie durch Backup, Patchmanagement, Monitoring und weitere Sicherheitsmaßnahmen einen stabilen und sicheren IT-Betrieb sicher
  • Dabei betreuen Sie Hard- und Software, pflegen technische Dokumentationen und arbeiten bei übergreifenden Themen mit externen IT-Dienstleistern zusammen

Qualifikation

  • Grundlage bildet eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration (m/w/d), IT-System-Elektroniker (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung
  • Idealerweise bringen Sie drei bis fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), Systemadministrator (m/w/d) oder Netzwerkadministrator (m/w/d) mit
  • Sie verfügen über gute Kenntnisse in der Server-, Netzwerk- und Clientadministration sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Windows Server, Exchange und Virtualisierung
  • Zusätzlich bringen Sie Kenntnisse in IT-Sicherheit, Backup und Patchmanagement mit
  • Wichtig sind sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten in Vollzeit
  • Sicherheit: Unbefristete Festanstellung im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung
  • Zentrale Lage: Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten in zentraler Lage
  • Weiterentwicklung: Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Team-Spirit: Sympathische Kollegen, wertschätzendes Miteinander und kurze Entscheidungswege

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung Vertrieb
description: Mut ist unser Antrieb, Zusammenhalt ist unsere Stärke. Seit über 160 Jahren begleiten wir Menschen zuverlässig durchs Leben – mit einem innovativen Portfolio an Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeprodukten. Als Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit gestalten wir gemeinsam mit mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft der Versicherung neu und legen dabei besonderen Wert auf soziale und ökologische Verantwortung. Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herzstück unseres Erfolgs. Wir leben eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur und heißen Menschen jeden Alters, jeder Herkunft und Lebensweise willkommen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten wollen. Kurz zusammengefasst – das erwartet dich Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Team bei der stetigen persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebspartnerinnen und Vertriebspartner innerhalb unserer Vertriebsorganisationen sowie bei der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben  Gemeinsam mit dem Team organisierst du Schulungen und unterstützt bei allen anfallenden Aufgaben rund um unsere Akademie, von der Planung bis zur Nachbereitung. Die Betreuung unserer Webinare liegt in deinen Händen: Du koordinierst Termine und Inhalte mit Referierenden, legst Veranstaltungen im Lernmanagementsystem an, bewirbst diese und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Für neue Mitarbeitende planst und koordinierst du gemeinsam mit den Trainerinnen die passenden Trainingsangebote, behältst Neueintritte im Blick und stimmst dich mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern ab. Im Rahmen der Akademie-Administration kümmerst du dich um Anmeldungen, Dokumentationen sowie die Pflege von Ein- und Austritten und sorgst für aktuelle und verlässliche Daten. In engem Austausch mit den Trainerinnen begleitest du die Entwicklung unserer Trainees, dokumentierst Fortschritte und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung von Lern- und Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du an der Optimierung digitaler Trainingsformate in Retorio mit, betreust Lernkohorten und unterstützt bei organisatorischen Themen wie Kick-off-Terminen, Projekten und der Rechnungsbearbeitung.   Das bringst du mit Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, (Wirtschafts-)Pädagogik, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie, Personalmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und kannst uns für mindestens zwei Semester mit 18 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Personalentwicklung, Aus- und Weiterbildung, Organisationsentwicklung, Vertriebsmanagement oder Prozessoptimierung gesammelt. Der Umgang mit Microsoft Office und digitalen Anwendungen fällt dir leicht. In neue Tools und Systeme arbeitest du dich schnell und gerne ein. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig, behältst Termine im Blick und setzt auch bei mehreren Themen die richtigen Prioritäten. Kommunikation zählt zu deinen Stärken: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern zusammen, stimmst dich proaktiv ab und bist ein verlässlicher Teamplayer. Mit deiner positiven Art, deiner Eigeninitiative und deiner Begeisterung für die Weiterentwicklung von Trainings und Prozessen bringst du frische Ideen ins Team ein. Neugierig geworden? Dann melde dich gerne direkt bei unserem Recruiter Michael (-2126). Wir freuen uns auf Dein Interesse ! Dein Ansprechpartner Michael Hobmaier #gerneperdu Telefon: 089/6787 - 2126 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

At Open-Xchange (OX), we develop open-source communication and collaboration software used by public sector organizations, telcos, and hosting providers to keep data secure and under their control. Our products cover email, collaboration, DNS security, and related services, and are used by millions of people worldwide.


Discover what OX offers you:

  • We work in a non-hierarchical organization that empowers everyone to take responsibility, stay focused, and contribute directly to the company’s success and customer value.

Your team:

You'll work in a dedicated cell built around one of our largest hosting customers - a provider running multiple brands on OX App Suite 8. Your closest collaborators are the Account Manager and Development Engineers, with Support looped in as needed. It's a largely independent seat, but you're one of several engineers across the company running the same model for other large accounts.


Your new job:

  • Be present in the customer relationship - regular calls, occasional on-site visits, and persistent continuity that the customer's technical teams know you by name and trust your word.
  • Build reference labs and generate reference configurations from them.
  • Participate in OX-internal development of those frameworks.
  • Analyze and resolve technical issues across the OX App Suite 8 stack. As L1/L2 is sitting with our customer your role is escalation-facing (L2/L3) taking ownership from escalation through to resolution and keeping the customer informed throughout.
  • Translate customer feature requests and operational requirements into clear input for internal product and development teams, and feedback internal constraints to the customer in terms they can act on.
  • Support the customer through upgrades, configuration changes, and new feature rollouts. Document solutions, workarounds, and deployment specifics - both for the customer and internally - and leave things better documented than you found them.
    Formal on-call is not part of this role.
  • A typical day mixes customer and internal calls, hands-on lab and reference-configuration work, and technical documentation - with occasional escalation support when a customer integration needs deeper troubleshooting.
  • Limited travel is required for customer-facing meetings (~1-2 per quarter) and company-internal meetings (~1 per quarter).


This is the tech stack you'll be working with:

Scale 1-5 where 5 means “hands-on depth expected on day one” and 1 means “we expect nothing and train it on the job”:

  • OX App Suite 8 | 1 |
  • Kubernetes (Helm-based deployments) | 5 |
  • Mail infrastructure: Dovecot (CE / Pro), Postfix, IMAP/SMTP) | 2 |
  • Data layer: MariaDB, Redis | 3 |
  • Storage: Object storage (S3-compatible), Rook Ceph | 2 |
  • Identity: Keycloak, LDAP | 2 |
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana (or comparable stack) | 3 |
  • Tooling: Linux, Bash/Python, kubectl, Helm | 5 |
  • Networking: Istio (operational awareness, not configuration ownership) | 2 |

  • Solid hands-on experience with Linux-based server environments.
  • Working knowledge of several core stack components - 
  • mail infrastructure (IMAP/SMTP, Dovecot or equivalent).
  • relational databases (MariaDB/MySQL).
  • containerized deployments on Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and alerting (Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent) is part of staying ahead of issues rather than just reacting to them.
  • We don't expect OX App Suite or Dovecot experience, we train it.
  • Practical experience troubleshooting distributed systems in production: reading logs across multiple services, correlating symptoms, and working through problems with a clear method.
  • Comfortable writing scripts to automate operational tasks or reproduce issues.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role - support engineering, professional services, or similar - where you have taken ownership of an issue or requirement from first contact through to resolution.
  • Familiarity with Helm-based deployments and the operational patterns that come with running multi-brand or multi-tenant hosting environments.
  • Able to work across teams and communicate technical details to people with different backgrounds: you can represent a customer's operational reality in an internal engineering discussion and translate an internal constraint back to the customer without losing either side.
  • Clear written communication is a requirement. Documentation and knowledge transfer are part of the job.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant (m/f/d) - Growth & Strategy
description: The Role This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility . You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work. You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth. There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market , initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows. What You’ll Be Doing Manage customer opportunities end-to-end , from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team. Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets. Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets. Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network . Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach , including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market. As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities. Your profile You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation . You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close. You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit. You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions . You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value. You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities . You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow . You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time . You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently. You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events , typically up to five days per month. A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us. Why us? You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done. You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work , with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events. The role comes with a strong fixed salary , with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow. You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget , home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats. You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like . Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for We’re looking for a highly organised & proactive Executive Assistant for our Executives. You will be the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, ensuring efficiency and seamless operations. Your focus will be on managing key personal & professional priorities, and providing administrative and strategic support—allowing our execs to focus on scaling the business through the next phase of growth! You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time as we’re scaling fast and building the category-defining agentic operating system for procurement. And we are looking for the best Executive Assistant out there to help us turn procurement into a true competitive advantage! What Can You Expect? As the backbone of Omnea’s executive office, you’ll proactively coordinate, manage and keep track of your assigned Exec's schedules, projects and commitments. You will work closely with the Omnea leadership team and act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders on all matters related to our execs. You are someone who acts like an owner, can craft at speed and loves working in a fast-paced environment with significant impact. You’ll provide strategic and executive support , by managing our executives' complex calendars, ensuring seamless scheduling across multiple time zones. You’ll own email and communication filtering as well as prioritising, drafting, and responding as necessary. You’ll act as a gatekeeper , ensuring our executives’ time is spent on high-impact activities. You will manage conflicting priorities and prioritise different demands, you’ll focus on solutions, and are comfortable navigating change and removing blockers. You’ll plan, schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure agendas are well prepped, action items tracked, minutes taken and follow-ups done in a timely manner. You’ll also assist with board materials, investor updates, and briefing notes. You’ll organise and book all travel , including flights, hotels, transfers and visas. You’ll prepare detailed travel itineraries and handle last-minute changes seamlessly. You’ll own all operational and administrative tasks, such as expenses, invoices, and budget tracking related to our executives' activities. You’ll act as the first point of contact for all key stakeholders, including prospects and customers on behalf of our executives. You’ll manage confidential information with the highest level of discretion. You’ll also proactively solve problems and anticipate potential issues before they arise. You’ll own systems & processes that improve productivity, such as identifying and implementing tools or processes that reduce admin workload and help outsource and delegate non-essential tasks effectively. About You You have a 3-5 years of work experience , this can be as an EA, PA, Chief of Staff or Founders Associate ideally in a high-growth startup or tech environment. You may not have the exact experience necessary for this role but you will have excelled at something incredibly challenging that demonstrates your ability to work hard under pressure in a fast-paced, stressful environment. For example, you may be a career changer who did well in a different sector or role but similarly intense & difficult. You are London-based , with 3 days in the office per week and flexibility for occasional travels with the CEO in the future. You are highly organised, with meticulous attention to detail , and exceptional at multitasking. You have flexibility to provide support during off-hours in an environment with increasingly different timezones (Europe & US). You are tech-savvy , with experience using modern productivity tools (e.g., Slack, Notion, Google Suite). You can provide structure within the entrepreneurial and dynamic environment of a company in hyper-scale. You’re able to ruthlessly prioritise, are highly organised and focused on outputs > inputs. You are proactive, a strategic thinker, efficient & autonomous and don’t compromise on quality (i.e. you have taste). You’re an outstanding communicator; verbal, written, and when presenting. You’re exceptionally articulate, concise and clear in all forms of communication and have the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec, technical expert or a junior operator. You handle confidential matters with discretion and professionalism. You’re outcomes-focused , and balance the ability to think strategically with a heavy bias to action, always focused on “so what’s the next step?”. You are proactive & crave accountability , proactively pushing initiatives forward and making the best use of the resources available to you. You’re just a really good human. You’re empathetic and reliable. You build trust with people you work with and are highly collaborative. You have minimal ego, seek feedback to continuously hone your craft and try to bring out the best in everyone around you. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Lendable's Payments team transacts money for our UK Loans, AutoLend (motor finance) and Zable (credit card) products: disbursing loans, collecting repayments, refunding customers and reconciling everything against our banking providers.

We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated.

This is a hands-on operational role and a strong first job in fintech. You don't need finance experience; we'll teach you the payments side. You do need to be numerate, methodical, quick to learn and comfortable being the last line of defence before money leaves the building.

What you'll do

Daily funding controls (core responsibility)

  • Run the daily pre-release checks on partner funding: gather payment evidence from our third-party partners, reconcile it to our disbursal records, and confirm that yesterday's funds reached the intended recipients before today's payments are approved.

  • Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it.

  • Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit.

  • Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early.

  • Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them.

  • Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions.

Payments and finance operations

  • Support day-to-day payment operations: cash allocation of incoming repayments, refunds and returned payments, and reconciliation against our bank and payment providers.

  • Prepare and check payment files for approval, for example, bulk payment files for customer refunds and complaint redress.

  • Pick up Finance Help Desk tickets from other teams: payment traces, refund and redress requests, "has this payment arrived" queries.

 

Partner indemnity recovery

  • Support the colleague who leads our partner indemnity recovery process. Where an agreement is cancelled, unwound or found to have been mis-sold, our partner agreements entitle us to recover amounts from the partner. You'll help validate each case against our records: confirming the agreement status, the amounts paid out and received, and what is contractually recoverable.

  • Prepare and reconcile the recovery figures that go to partners, track invoices raised against amounts received, and chase and resolve queries and shortfalls.

  • Support the unwind process on cancelled agreements: making sure customer refunds, partner recoveries and internal ledger entries all tie back to the same numbers.

  • Help bring the recovery backlog under control and keep an accurate, up-to-date view of what is outstanding by partner.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • A degree (2:1 or above, or equivalent) in a STEM, finance, accounting, economics or other quantitative subject, completed within the last two years.

  • Strong numeracy and comfort working with large volumes of transactional data.

  • Strong attention to detail and healthy scepticism. You can quickly identify when supporting documentation, such as a bank statement, does not fully evidence what it is intended to.

  • Confident with Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, filters and tidy, checkable working.

  • Clear written communication. You can explain to a non-finance colleague why a payment has been held.

  • Confident dealing with external partners: obtaining documentation promptly and professionally, and politely pushing back where it is incomplete.

  • Comfortable handling sensitive customer, partner and payment data responsibly.

Nice to have

  • Some exposure to Python, SQL or a similar language from your degree, a project or self-study, and an appetite to use it to automate repetitive work. We use Snowflake.

  • An internship, placement or project involving finance, operations or messy real-world data.

  • An interest in payments, lending or how money moves between businesses.

What success looks like at 6 months

  • The daily funding control runs reliably across the agreed partner population with a full evidence trail, and no payment is released without the previous day's funds being evidenced.

  • Exceptions and emerging trends are flagged early, documented and resolved with the right teams.

  • Partner and payee bank details have been verified on the agreed cycle.

  • The partner indemnity recovery backlog has been validated, invoiced where due and is tracked in one accurate, up-to-date view.

  • The funding control is documented end-to-end and materially more automated than when you started.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

raw.title: Data-driven Digital Consultant (mid-level) - UK (Hybrid)
raw.description:
Want to join a company that works on real world problems that make a difference to people’s lives? We are focused on changing how we build what’s around us, helping people to design and construct buildings and infrastructure more efficiently.
 
Do you have experience of large capital projects in the built environment? Are you passionate about leading data-centric solutions to solve the frustrations and complex problems faced by the industry? We want to hear from you.
 
Interested? Read on!
_____________________________________________________________________________________
We are Laminar Projects!
 
We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)
 
We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.
 
The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 200 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job”, we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.
 
Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 
  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 
 
4 core values for a good life
 
We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.
 
We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  
  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society
_____________________________________________________________________________________
The Role
 
Purpose of the role
We are looking for experienced Digital Consultants to join our team. You will leverage your industry experience to deeply understand clients' problems, advise them on best practice and deliver data-driven digital solutions tailored to their needs. You will be a proactive individual who directs technical teams to deliver impactful results and excels at communicating complex concepts to less technical audiences.
 
Team 
The Data & Digital team helps people to use data effectively to improve the performance of their projects or organisations. To do this effectively and at scale we use the modern digital technologies including Azure, Fabric, Power BI and Python. We pride ourselves on being structured and outcome driven, helping us to build the best solutions and helping us to continuously improve what we do.
 
Your top 5 responsibilities
  1. Solve our clients’ most complex business problems: Develop data-driven digital solutions tailored to clients' needs by fully understanding their business processes and challenging the status quo.
  2. Implement best practice data solutions: Work with our technical experts and lead junior team members to deliver to clients’ expectations by successfully communicating complex business concepts and requirements.
  3. Develop internal Laminar data solutions: Helping Laminar to become data driven by leveraging digital technologies to collect organisation data and enhance operational efficiency.
  4. Productisation of client solutions: Work with our technical teams to develop products that work across different clients.
  5. Following and developing our processes: Following our best practices and identifying areas for us to improve by refining or introducing new processes.
 
Your Capabilities
As a candidate, you should have: 
  • Degree educated in one of the following: Engineering, Surveying, Project Management, or similar.
  • 5+ years experience in the engineering/construction of large capital projects (>USD 100m).
  • 2+ years experience driving data and digital solutions set up and implementation across an organisation or large project.
  • Great communication skills, able to translate complex ideas in a clear and concise manner to a wide variety of audiences.
  • Demonstrable passion for digital transformation and improving the delivery of Capital Projects, with the curiosity to learn the latest digital tools and processes across project life cycle.
  • Have an analytical mindset and be able to create structure and clarity from uncertainty. 
 
It would also be great if you have: 
  • Chartered in relevant body (e.g. ICE, RICS) or moving towards chartership.
  • PMP/APM membership and/or MBA.
  • Consultancy experience.
  • Working knowledge of information management best practice.
  • Product Management/Software development experience.
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g. Power BI).
  • Experience with databases (e.g. SQL, Azure) 
 
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 
  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Benefits 
 
The standard stuff:  
- Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority  
- Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings  
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance  
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft  
- Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment  
 
The life-changing stuff: 
- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally – professionally and as a human being 
- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it 
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins 
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up 
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Important! Applying properly
 
We get hundreds of applications so please ensure your CV one or two pages. You will also be asked the following questions: 
  • What new opportunities or experiences are you seeking in this role that your current position hasn’t provided?
  • Describe a complex business problem you recently solved through a data-driven solution and what was the impact to the project or organisation. 
 
We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders.
 
You must be located and have the current right to work in the UK. We can support the transfer of existing UK visas, but cannot sponsor new visas.
 
In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

negotiating complex commercial agreements across global system integrator arrangements, channel partner and reseller agreements, technology alliance and co-sell agreements, enterprise SaaS and platform licensing, API and technical integration agreements, and distribution and go-to-market partnerships.</p> </li> <li> <p>Advise senior business stakeholders, including GTM leadership, and description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: We're looking for an AI-native Senior Product Designer to help drive the design of our Sexual Health experience — one of Hims & Hers' founding and highest-engagement categories. You'll partner closely with Design, Product Management, Clinical, and Engineering to design a best-in-class telemedicine experience across the sexual health journey, from first visit through ongoing treatment. This role sits at the intersection of two mandates: sharpening what already exists and defining what comes next. You'll spend real time in the current app — refining flows, fixing friction, and raising the visual and interaction bar on existing features — while also using AI-native design tools and workflows to prototype and pressure-test where the sexual health experience should go over the next several product generations. You should be equally comfortable shipping a polished iteration this sprint and sketching a bolder, AI-shaped version of the product for next year. You are a user-centric designer and problem solver who is motivated, ego-free, and always looking to improve, ideate, and refine. You're comfortable being both strategic and executional, working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, and translating dense, sensitive, and often stigmatized subject matter into design that feels simple, human, and trustworthy. You Will: Elevate the Current Product Own and iterate on the sexual health app experience today — flows, journey maps, wireframes, and high-fidelity visual design across onboarding, diagnosis intake, treatment selection, refills, and check-ins. Identify friction, inconsistency, and drop-off in the existing product and design measurable improvements. Lead large initiatives or multiple concurrent projects with autonomy. Design with AI, Natively Bring an AI-native workflow to your craft — using AI tools for research synthesis, rapid concept generation, prototyping, and content/copy exploration — to move faster from insight to tested concept. Explore how AI-powered features (personalization, triage, guided decision-making, ongoing care support) could become part of the sexual health product itself, not just part of how you design it. Build Toward the Future App Translate where sexual health care is headed into concrete product direction. Partner with Product and Clinical to define a longer-term vision for the category, and design the connective tissue between today's app and that future state — so every current iteration is also a step toward it. Champion the User Deeply understand the needs, anxieties, and behaviors of people seeking sexual health care — a category where trust, discretion, and empathy are as important as usability. Participate in customer research, testing, and iteration to ensure the product isn't just easy to use, but reduces stigma and builds confidence at every step. Collaborate and Communicate Partner with Design, Product Managers, Research, Clinical, and Engineering to navigate complex, sensitive problems and drive projects from start to finish. Develop deep product and category expertise, become a trusted partner to stakeholders, and communicate decisions and process with clarity and empathy. description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The Team You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale. Working closely with Protect (our second line) and across all operations functions, you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance support looks like here, keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow. The Service Guild at Griffin is the mindful engine room, driving our success. We strive to bring joy to our customers, both internal and external, through systems that just work. There are four core elements to operations at Griffin: fincrime, payments, treasury ops and operational resilience. Across all teams, we place significant emphasis on compassion, ownership and curiosity. You will be empowered to make meaningful decisions and supported to make sure we collectively get those decisions right. The opportunity We want compliance built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into. What success looks like In your first year, our operations, sales and product teams bring you in early by default, because working with you makes things smoother, not slower. You've guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. Our live products have clear governance and outcome monitoring, and Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation in place. To do this you'll be involved in: Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments from first idea through product approval to launch. Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures. Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material. raw.title: Compliance Advisory Manager (1st line)
raw.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Operational Controls team within the Service guild, the backbone of how Griffin stays compliant and keeps operational risk visible and manageable as we scale. Working closely with Protect (our second line) and across all operations functions, you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance support looks like here, keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The Service Guild at Griffin is the mindful engine room, driving our success. We strive to bring joy to our customers, both internal and external, through systems that just work.

There are four core elements to operations at Griffin: fincrime, payments, treasury ops and operational resilience. Across all teams, we place significant emphasis on compassion, ownership and curiosity. You will be empowered to make meaningful decisions and supported to make sure we collectively get those decisions right.

The opportunity

We want compliance built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

What success looks like

In your first year, our operations, sales and product teams bring you in early by default, because working with you makes things smoother, not slower. You've guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. Our live products have clear governance and outcome monitoring, and Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation in place.

To do this you'll be involved in:

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments from first idea through product approval to launch.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on both our marketing materials and ensuring that our customer's marketing materials are compliant with regulation and our own internal policies. Also ensuring that our own financial promotions are compliant and challenged appropriately.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations.

  • A hands on approach. You've turned regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams, and you're comfortable interpreting and applying FCA rules to new situations.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn't right.

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have worked in finance or Banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. Benefits Be part of a creative, world-leading team Competitive salary and share options scheme Contributory pension scheme Group private medical insurance scheme Life Assurance Cycle-to-work Scheme Central London location EEO Statement Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010. Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
Suite à une croissance rapide et rentable en France, Doctrine s'est développée en Italie et en Allemagne, puis a racheté Maïté, une legaltech espagnole, au début de l'année 2026. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un·e Engineering Manager pour continuer à améliorer notre IA juridique sur le marché espagnol. 
C’est un rôle stratégique qui impactera la roadmap produit et les futurs succès de Doctrine en Espagne.
 
À noter : le poste est basé à Paris, dans nos bureaux du 18e arrondissement.
 
Tu trouveras le détail de notre stack technique sur Github !
 
Bon à savoir : une expérience professionnelle préalable dans le domaine juridique n'est pas requise. En revanche, l'envie de t'investir et de monter en compétence sur la compréhension de documents juridiques est essentielle.

description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.
